rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement structure (hardwood floor, drywall) and contents (boxes) caused by failure of the policyholder's own plumbing system.
claim_summary: Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned home to find approximately 2 inches of water flooding the entire basement due to a failed plumbing line.
